scope: Source-only review of the minimal inline newsletter subscription form for website readers entering an email and submitting. Evidence is the complete supplied HTML, with no runtime observations. Focus is input and submission; page layout and shared foundations are excluded. Review only; no interface edits or browser execution.

items.title: Label
items.evidence: tests/design-guide/fixtures/form.html:1-3 (complete supplied HTML; CSS at line 2)
items.reason: The sole input has no label element or explicit accessible-name attribute; the placeholder supplies an example rather than a persistent field label.
items.impact: The field loses its instructional cue when the placeholder is replaced by entered text, making later review and correction harder.
items.fix: Add a persistent Email address label associated with the input using matching for and id attributes.
items.verify: Inspect the association in source, then verify the label remains visible while entering an address and inspect the computed accessible name in a browser.
